land.text: the Colony of Fiji, which 'operated as a Crown colony until 1970' (founded by the Deed of Cession of 10 October 1874)

predecessors.note: The Colony of Fiji has no dossier of its own. Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire row (1969-1995) still contains 70 of Fiji's 83 land cells in 1980, so the British dossier must hand Fiji over in 1970. The earlier Kingdom of Fiji (1871-1874, dossier kingdom-of-fiji) was ceded to Britain and is the colony's predecessor, not this state's.

capitals.name: Suva
capitals.note: The Fiji page gives only the present capital ('Capital and largest city: Suva 18°10′S 178°27′E'); no earlier capital or move is recorded in the pages opened.

correction.text: Fiji as the Dominion of Fiji from independence on 10 October 1970: 'an archipelago of more than 330 islands' including Rotuma and the Lau Group

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's Republic of Fiji begins in 1973, but Fiji 'gained independence as the Dominion of Fiji' on 10 October 1970 (Fiji infobox; History of Fiji). The ledger's 1970 found event carries the birth.

correction.text: the whole archipelago: 'more than 330 islands', with Rotuma 'located 220 nautical miles' north of the main group and 'the remote Lau Group'

keyframe_review.note: 21,696 km2 against the infobox 18,274 km2 (ratio 1.19, fine). But the outline (bbox 177.14-179.86E, 19.13-16.17S) cannot reach Rotuma (about 12.5S) or the Lau Group east of 180E: at the gazetteer's grid it holds 73 land cells against 83 for the Natural Earth country polygon, and all 5 Eastern Division cells and Rotuma lie outside it. The country spec draws every island the page names.

correction.text: the whole archipelago, as for 1973-2023 (same outline in Cliopatria)

keyframe_review.note: Same outline and area as the 1973 shape; same correction.

region.text: Fiji, 'a Crown colony until 1970': 'The British granted Fiji independence in 1970'

ledger.note: 1970: Fiji becomes independent from the United Kingdom as the Dominion of Fiji. Infobox 'Independence: 10 October 1970'; 'The Union Jack was lowered for the last time at sunset on 9 October 1970' and the Fijian flag raised after dawn on 10 October. History of Fiji: 'Fiji became independent on 10 October 1970' as 'an independent Commonwealth realm'. The page names the country, not Rotuma or the Lau Group separately.

1987: after two military coups Fiji is declared a republic. 'Rabuka staged a second coup on 25 September 1987' and 'declared Fiji a republic on 10 October, the seventeenth anniversary of Fiji's independence'; Fiji was expelled from the Commonwealth. The Fiji infobox gives 'Republic: 6 October 1987' (the pages disagree by days). No land changes.

1997: the Republic of Fiji becomes the Republic of the Fiji Islands under the new constitution. Infobox: 'changed from Dominion of Fiji to Republic of Fiji and then in 1997 to Republic of the Fiji Islands'. No land changes.
2011: the official name reverts to Republic of Fiji. 'The official name of the country was reverted to Republic of Fiji in February 2011.' No land changes.

certainty.note: Island coasts; maritime limits are not drawn. The remote reef Ceva-i-Ra ('about 250 nautical miles' southwest) and Ono-i-Lau, 'the most outlying island group', lie far from the main islands and are named by the Fiji page without a boundary.

sources.title: History of Fiji
sources.note: Independence, the two 1987 coups and the republic of 10 October, the 1997 constitution, the 2000 and 2006 coups; silent on Rotuma's incorporation and on any border change after 1970.

notes: Cliopatria rows. (1) The Republic of Fiji row starts 1973 and its shape is the same to 2024; the state is independent from 10 October 1970, so a 1970-1972 keyframe is added and the ledger's found event is dated 1970. (2) Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire row (1969-1995) still contains 70 of Fiji's 83 land cells in 1980 (gazetteer intersect), so Fiji is drawn British until 1995; the eu-11 dossier should end it in 1970. (3) The outline omits Rotuma and the Lau Group; the keyframes correct to the country polygon. Not on the pages opened: when Rotuma joined the colony (the History page mentions Rotuma only as a place of exile), the Minerva Reefs dispute with Tonga (Fiji page silent), Conway Reef claims, and the date Suva became the capital. The 1987, 2000 and 2006 coups changed governments, not borders, so wars is empty; the pages disagree on the day of the 1987 republic (6 vs 10 October). identity.start follows the independence date (the way papua-new-guinea does), not Cliopatria's 1973. The Colony of Fiji (1874-1970) has no dossier; suggested slug colony-of-fiji, for the oc-02-x additions batch.
